thread:
maria: FYI, small percentage of EU/APAC onboarding webhooks hit transient failures this morning. SRE root cause points to an autoscaler concurrency edge. Working a CS outbound.

alex: Thanks. How many accounts affected and any renewal risk customers?

maria: ~20 accounts flagged, 6 are high-touch / renewal-risk. Impact window ~07:55-08:45 UTC. No data loss.

jamie: Timeline: 07:55 errors spike; 08:02 mitigations (reduced provisioning concurrency) rolled; 08:25 autoscaler hotfix; 08:40 error rate back to baseline. Owner: SRE (jamie) + Provisioning Eng (raj).

raj: Mitigations: added short jitter + strict concurrency cap for provisioning flows; alert rules tightened. We'll include these in mini-RCA.

emily: I'll handle FR/DE/JA templates for CS — need final English copy.

alex: Draft short customer note for CS outbound: 

```
Hi <Name>,

We experienced intermittent delays for new tenant webhook activations in EU and APAC between 07:558:45 UTC. The issue was caused by an autoscaler concurrency edge during heavy parallel onboarding. We deployed a fix and monitoring shows normal behavior. No data was lost.

What were offering: one week of priority onboarding support + a 10% onboarding usage credit for affected customers.

If you still see onboarding failures, reply or open a ticket and we'll prioritize you.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference
```

maria: Add legal line: "Reply to request a full incident report for auditors." Also tag impacted accounts with incident:onboard-1789999999 and escalate the 6 renewal-risk customers.

emily: I'll post translations in ~30m and include JST office hours for APAC.

raj: Once CS confirms impacted list, I'll queue credits.

sarah-bot: Monitoring: error rate <0.02% for last 30m, recovery confirmed at 08:40 UTC.

alex: Plan: send targeted emails to 20 accounts after translations + legal line. Full RCA targeted in 3 business days. Closing thread for edits only.
